title: Wnt/beta-Catenin Signaling Pathway Targeting Androgenetic Alopecia: How Far Can We Go Beyond Minoxidil and Finasteride?
authors: Zhi, Jia; Feng, Meiling; Feng, Xilong; Niu, Xiaotian; Chen, Wenchao; Jiang, Xiaoying; Bai, Renren
one_liner_zh: 该文综述Wnt/β-catenin通路靶向治疗雄激素性脱发，虽含分子对接分析，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The prevalence of AGA is continuously rising, with an earlier age of onset. Currently, only minoxidil and finasteride have received FDA approval for the treatment of AGA, inadequately addressing the pressing clinical needs. Recently, the involvement of the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway in AGA has attracted increased research interest. This perspective manuscript provides a comprehensive evaluation of the potential of targeting the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway for next-generation AGA therapies. We systematically outlined its central role in regulating the hair follicle cycle and emphasized the therapeutic potential and mechanisms of key targets, including DKK, Dvl-CXXC5, Axin and GSK-3beta. Moreover, we discussed the structural design and modification of various pathway activators, including DKK inhibitors and GSK-3beta inhibitors, and presented extensive molecular docking analyses to elucidate the SARs. The insights presented will contribute to a comprehensive and unique perspective on the future discovery and development of therapeutics for AGA.
abstract_zh: AGA的患病率持续上升，且发病年龄趋于年轻化。目前，仅有米诺地尔（minoxidil）和非那雄胺（finasteride）获得FDA批准用于治疗AGA，难以满足迫切的临床需求。近年来，Wnt/beta-catenin信号通路在AGA中的作用引起了越来越多的研究兴趣。本观点性文稿对靶向Wnt/beta-catenin通路用于下一代AGA疗法的潜力进行了全面评估。我们系统阐述了该通路在调节毛囊周期中的核心作用，并强调了关键靶点（包括DKK、Dvl-CXXC5、Axin和GSK-3beta）的治疗潜力及其机制。此外，我们讨论了多种通路激活剂（包括DKK抑制剂和GSK-3beta抑制剂）的结构设计与修饰，并通过广泛的分子对接分析阐明了其构效关系（SARs）。所提出的见解将为未来AGA治疗药物的发现与开发提供全面而独特的视角。
